results.title: Ürei
results.overview: When a young girl is left with her aging grandmother in rural Kazakhstan, an ordinary act of familial care quickly turns into an unsettling descent into the unknown where loss can take monstrous forms.

results.title: Making of Lord of the Flies
results.original_title: Making of Lord of the Flies
results.overview: A trippy tale capturing the creative vision of writer Jack Thorne and director Marc Munden, as a British crew and young cast film this timely adaptation on the remote islands of Malaysia during monsoon season. The crew battle twisters, torrential rain and scary insects to create this hallucinatory fever dream, featuring behind-the-scenes interviews and mesmerising performances by the newbie cast.

results.title: L'Infiltrée
results.overview: To fulfill his dream of becoming a secret agent, Maxime has to become... Lupita!

results.title: Czech Girl
results.overview: Widowed Zdena lives a quiet life as a postwoman in a small Czech village. When her beloved son Lukas returns home from France to say goodbye to his dying grandmother, his determination to make her seemingly impossible wish come true leads him to reveal a secret that challenges the values of the village: his queer life in Paris and his drag queen alter ego, Chica Checa.

results.title: Growth
results.overview: "Growth" is a hilarious documentary about cancer. No, really. "Growth" explores the healing power of laughter and asks, "How do you joke about cancer? CAN you joke about cancer? And WHY should you joke about cancer?"

results.title: Nar'sata: Sekutu Setan
results.overview: Balqis grew up in suffering and betrayal. Driven by revenge, she chose a dark path without realizing that every action has a price.

results.title: Our Land
results.overview: In 2009, a man and two accomplices try to evict members of the Indigenous community of Chuschagasta in northern Argentina. Claiming ownership of the land and armed with guns, they kill the community’s leader, Javier Chocobar. The murder is caught on video. It takes nine years of protests before court proceedings are finally opened in 2018. During all this time, the killers remain free. The film combines the voices and photographs of the community with courtroom footage to explore the long history of colonialism and land dispossession that led to this crime.

results.title: Rom Coms Must Die
results.overview: A disgruntled filmmaker and his sidekick cousin takes drastic actions to get their second film produced in a changing world of motion picture storytelling.

results.title: Yen Ennai Edho Seidhai
results.overview: Broken young man trapped in emotional darkness finds unexpected healing when Madhu's love guides him from self destruction toward hope, purpose, and light.

results.title: Wo die Stille tötet - Mord in der Wüste
results.original_title: Wo die Stille tötet - Mord in der Wüste
results.overview: When her son Dominik disappears without a trace in Namibia, Hannah Jansen, a cashier from Berlin, travels to Africa on her own. She is accompanied by Vincent, a seemingly harmless tour guide. Together, they uncover a web of corruption, geopolitical interests, and personal guilt.

results.title: Old Maid
results.overview: Two feuding cousins play a common Victorian parlor game to test fate but call on spirits they did not expect and face deadly consequences.

results.title: The Beast of Riverside Hollow
results.overview: Residents of a sleepy English village investigate a werewolf threat lurking in the nearby moors. Led by a punk band and eccentric locals, they race to unravel the mystery and reclaim their village from this dark danger.

results.title: The Agonist
results.overview: Sebastián was born with spasticity. Living with that discomfort, he films his life: his loves, friends, children and family. But as the years go by, the pain in his body becomes too much to bear, and the idea of risky brain surgery that could change him forever takes hold. Is that what he really wants? Is he ready to become someone else?

results.title: Soap Fever
results.overview: With the Soviet Union’s dissolution dragging down the economy of neighboring Finland, the Scandinavian country was plunged in a period of protracted recession. And with no recovery in sight, a soap opera offered Finns a respite from the grim reality; the debut of The Bold and the Beautiful on television quickly amassed a vast and dedicated following, whereas the arrival of American idols in the country, on tour, elicited unprecedented frenzy.

results.title: The Dream Is a Snail
results.overview: A struggling young artist takes an odd job as a human racetrack in a senior rejuvenation workshop, only to develop an obsession with the hypnotic sensation of snails gliding across his skin.

results.title: Disney Pixar Cars: Race to Celebrate
results.original_title: Disney Pixar Cars: Race to Celebrate
results.overview: 'There’s a new holiday in Radiator Springs – Lightning McQueen Day! But shhhh … it’s a surprise!  Celebrate 20 years of Disney and Pixar’s Cars with a surprise party in Radiator Springs!  Return to Radiator Springs for an all-new adventure just in time for the 20th anniversary of the original Cars film! This story is sure to delight fans of all ages as Mater, Sally, Cruz, and their friends throw a surprise party to celebrate their favorite racer on the first annual Lightning McQueen Day.'

results.title: Why Don't We Just Kill Ourselves?
results.overview: Welcome to Rozumov—a village where everyone knows everything about everyone else, where neighborly feuds are passed down from generation to generation, and no scandal stays hidden behind closed gates for long. For years, the village has been torn apart by a feud between two irreconcilable families. On one side stands the Šmrha family, on the other the Průša family, and both are convinced that truth, honor, and common sense reside solely with them. Their children, Karel and Marie, however, are secretly in love despite their fathers’ wishes. When Marie, after yet another family spat, agrees to participate in the reality TV show Blind Wedding, she causes quite a stir in Rozumov. Karel is distraught, the parents are furious, and a TV crew—along with an eccentric Swedish metalhead—arrives in the village. So, in a haze of alcohol, Šmrha and Průša call an unexpected truce and devise a plan to save their children from a televised embarrassment: they’ll secretly marry them off by proxy.

results.title: Rake
results.overview: A young accountant from a provincial settlement suffers from the tyranny of his mother and is looking for an answer to the reasons for his father's suicide. The desire to change the direction of his life pushes him to flee to Moscow, where by the will of fate he finds himself in the life of an underground casino.

results.title: Caity
results.overview: Along with her newly sober father Paul, 16-year-old Caity prepares for the new Halloween season of their family-owned haunted house. When she recognizes signs of a relapse from Paul, she tries to cover them up but struggles to manage as she tests her own relationship to substances and an attraction to new employee Hannah.
